content: LLM-as-judge biases: self-preference (judge favors own outputs, familiar/low-perplexity text; range -38% to +90% on ArenaHard), position bias (order swap shifts accuracy >10% pairwise), verbosity bias (judge ratings track length r=.87 vs human .44), scoring sensitivity to rubric order/ID type. Mitigations: pointwise scoring or randomize/swap order, ensemble judges, report inter-judge agreement, avoid same model judging its own output, calibrate against human votes.
